title: Name, family naming and French heritage; introductions for the tape
summary: He gives his full name, explains the John and Paul names in the family and the French spoken around him, and everyone states their name for the tape.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: My name is John G-O-H-N, capital D-E, capital D-R-O-I-T, Good Rock. And the middle name? No middle name. In my family there were two uncles who had money. One was named John and one was named Paul. And in the whole family you find nothing but John and Paul. That's what you call a coincidence.
You call that ignorance. They used to speak French so I couldn't understand them.

When I went to high school, the professor, your mother's a solitary, your father's a good guy, you don't speak French, you're a disgrace to the French race. I thought I'm an American, I'm not a Frenchman. But that didn't do any good. But he was too good for boys, I went to school, he had no name. Just call boys, hi.

Let me get my name and Betty's name done. Betty, can you give yours? This is Betty Rankin. Yeah, and I'm Dick Allen. And I'm Tom Hedley Droid. So we all know each other's name and we have that on the tape.
Just looking at you, you were kindred spirits.
No, I was the world's worst musician. That's why I quit. But I'm glad to know about your family background.
